values.note: No potable water anywhere in the Canaan Mountain Backcountry: bring water or treat stream water.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/canaan-mountain-backcountry ('Potable water is not available at this site. Purify all water or bring your own.'), last updated 2026-03-23, read 2026-10-20

summary: The Monongahela NF Canaan Mountain Backcountry page (updated 2026-03-23) says nothing about fees, booking or the roadside dispersed sites themselves, so the free / first-come values stand as they were. Added: no potable water. The page confirms driving is permitted on the ~18-mile Canaan Loop Road (caution for low-clearance vehicles; motor vehicles restricted to roads and parking areas), and that its northern portions are private land needing Allegheny Wood Products' permission.
